review.description: Retained prior reviewed evidence for unchanged branch inputs: Against advanced main, PR3 S4 metadata-only PR/recovered-question event mapping remains changed behavior; stable delivery IDs, callback validation, retries and unavailable real-host subscription stay. Target confirmation prevents false local asks without adding host capability.
review.implementation: Retained prior reviewed evidence for unchanged branch inputs: Current events code still constructs metadata instead of copying private event body. Integrated atomic attention resolution/replacement preserves history and request identity; recovery completion/uncertainty never answers or authorizes notifications. No callback/auth/signing or host subscription behavior is broadened. Rebase comparison against9c549ce retains these owning source paths; conflict changes concern the shared transport, reporting shell and reconciliation context rather than changing this contract.
review.tests: Retained prior reviewed evidence for unchanged branch inputs: Changed event fixture injects private question context, checks absent body and exactly one inbox+attention notification over repeated ticks. Existing challenge/signature/entity/503-ID/expiry assertions retain limits. All inherited confirmed/unconfirmed request tests are local agent fixtures and do not supply callback receipt or renewal/host proof. Existing host and delivery-variant gaps remain unchanged; combined full-base verification is recorded separately; restored question detection reuses existing metadata-only attention events and grants no host notification acceptance.
